chunks.text: Microsoft shares are down about 13% from their all-time highs. Yahoo Finance reports investors worry about AI spending. Microsoft spent $45.2 billion on capex last quarter to add computing capacity. Free cash flow still stayed positive at $18.6 billion. Azure revenue grew 48% from a year earlier. Microsoft holds 21% of the global cloud infrastructure market, behind Amazon. Nearly 4 million companies use Microsoft 365. Is your company already using Copilot at work?
